brief.scope: Compare currently available U.S. battery-electric vehicle models and trims for model years 2025-2026. Assess EPA efficiency, range, price/incentives, charging costs, maintenance, reliability concerns, recalls, warranty, and 5- and 10-year ownership costs. Use a clearly declared 12,000-mile annual driving baseline and show electricity-price, home/public charging mix, insurance, depreciation, incentive, and ownership-duration sensitivities; leave geography-dependent inputs unknown unless a location is supplied.

terminology.efficiency: EPA combined MPGe and kWh per 100 miles, with test year, model year, trim, and wheel configuration.
terminology.total cost of ownership: Purchase price less eligible incentives plus financing, energy, maintenance/repair, insurance, registration/taxes, charging equipment, and depreciation over an explicitly stated horizon.
